name: Haruka
source:
The protagonist's oldest sister. She is a high school teacher and her brother's homeroom teacher.

Because of her looks and style, she is an idol at school. She is kind and patient, but when she gets stressed out, she plays pranks on her little brother to relieve her stress. 

She plans to marry her fiancé in six months, but the truth is...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240711015600/http://chiroame.sakura.ne.jp/game/007/kyara.html] archived official site[/url]]
